KustoQueries.Title: DoesRegionHasCapacityForNewLimit
KustoQueries.KustoQuery: let increaseLimit = <INCREASE_LIMIT>; let region = "<REGION>"; let environment = 'PROD'; let collapseSku = case(region in ("eastus","centralindia"), "Intel", "AMD"); let skuFamily = case(collapseSku == 'AMD', 'standardDASv5Family', collapseSku == 'Intel', 'standardDSv5Family', collapseSku == 'gpu_small', 'standardNVSv4Family', 'StandardNVADSA10v5Family'); let ConstrainedRegion = datatable(Region:string, Sku:string)["westeurope","All","southcentralus","All","EastUS","AMD","centralindia","All"]; let partnerId = "e3171dd9-9a5f-e5be-b36c-cc7c4f3f3bcf"; let partnerSubs = cluster('cpcdatasharingp.westus3.kusto.windows.net').database('Reporting').SubscrTypeEntity_MV | where Type != "ResourceGroupSubscription" | where Environment == environment | where ReservedPartnerId == partnerId | distinct SubscriptionId; let isConstrained = toscalar( ConstrainedRegion | where Region == region and (Sku == collapseSku or Sku == "All") | count ) > 0; let EarlyOut = print should_grant = false, reason = strcat("Region '", region, "' is constrained for SKU ", collapseSku) | where isConstrained; let FullCalc = cluster('cpcdatasharingp.westus3.kusto.windows.net').database('Reporting').DailySubscrRgCapacityEntity_Snapshot | where isConstrained == false | join kind=inner (partnerSubs) on SubscriptionId | where Region == region | where DPUData__IngestedTimestamp > ago(1d) | where QuotaName =~ skuFamily | where ConfigStatus == 'Ready' | summarize arg_max(DPUData__IngestedTimestamp, *) by SubscriptionId, StampName | summarize used = sum(QuotaCurrentValue), limit = sum(QuotaLimit) | extend new_used = used + increaseLimit | extend percent_used = round(todouble(used) / todouble(limit) * 100, 2) | extend new_percent_used = round(todouble(new_used) / todouble(limit) * 100, 2) | extend should_grant = new_percent_used < 80 | extend reason = case(should_grant, "Enough capacity in region", "Region cannot accomodate capacity"); union (EarlyOut), (FullCalc) | take 1

IncidentProcessingGuide: Customer is asking for a quota increase. You need to evaluate if Microsoft should approve it.
Create an EXECUTION_PLAN using the below guidelines:
Step 1: Add the 'Quota_Request' TAG to the Incident.
Step 2: Fetch Current Subscription Quota Limit: Execute the Geneva Action 'GetQuota' (inputParameters are: region, subscriptionId, quotaId). Post the findings in the IcM discussion.
Step 3: Determine Increase Needed: Calculate the required increase by comparing the requested limit against the current quota limit obtained in step 2.
Step 4: If quotaId is general_i_v2 or general_a_v2, run the Kusto query 'DoesRegionHasCapacityForNewLimit' to know if it is ok to grant quota.

Step 5: Interpret Kusto Results: There are three possible. 1) Limit increase is granted. In that case proceed with step 6.  2) The region is at capacity (but not fully constrained). In that case, post that info in the IcM discussion. 3) The region is fully constrained. If so, post this exact message in the IcM:

`Due to heightened customer demand in the West Europe (Netherlands) datacenter region, currently, there are restrictions on newly created subscriptions and/or additional quota requests. Ensuring capacity availability for our customers is a top priority for Microsoft and we are working to expedite additional capacity to the region.  In the meantime, we recommend that you use one of these alternate EU regions for Microsoft Dev Box: 
italynorth, germanywestcentral, switzerlandnorth, uksouth, northeurope, swedencentral
With all of this in mind, we are expediting expansion and are improving our resource deployment process to respond to this strong customer demand. We have identified several improvements on how we load-balance under a high resource usage situation, and how to trigger the timely deployment of needed resources. At this time, unfortunately, we are not able to provide a specific timeline, as to when this capacity will be increased for West EU. 
We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this situation may cause and appreciate your understanding and patience.`
Step 6: Ask confirmation to increase the limit. Once approved, increase the limit using the Geneva Action 'IncreaseQuota'. Post the results in the IcM discussion
